injuries.name: Jalen Johnson
injuries.detail: Johnson (ankle) is questionable to play Monday against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Kingston Flemings
injuries.detail: Flemings (suspension) won't play in Monday's game against Indiana, Andrew Schlecht of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Jock Landale
injuries.detail: Landale (hip) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Indiana.

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.detail: Gueye underwent surgery Tuesday to repair a fractured left foot that he suffered during a workout last week, Brad Rowland of the Locked On Podcast Network reports.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.detail: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Egor Demin
injuries.detail: The Nets exercised Demin's third-year team option for the 2027-28 season, Sharif Phillips-Keaton of USA Today reports Thursday.

injuries.name: Mikel Brown Jr.
injuries.detail: Brown (rest) is out for Sunday's game in Indiana.

injuries.name: Tyler Bilodeau
injuries.detail: Bilodeau (shoulder) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against Indiana.

injuries.name: Devin Carter
injuries.detail: Carter has been diagnosed with mononucleosis and is without a timetable for a return, Gary Washburn of The Boston Globe reports.

injuries.name: Mitchell Robinson
injuries.detail: Robinson (rest) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Magic.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.detail: Knueppel (hamstring) is listed as out for Monday's game versus the Pistons.

injuries.name: Grant Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (hamstring) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Pistons.

injuries.name: Nic Claxton
injuries.detail: Claxton (hamstring) is listed as doubtful for Monday's game against Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Jalen Smith
injuries.detail: Smith (finger) is listed as probable for Monday's game against Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Tobe Awaka
injuries.detail: Awaka (ankle) is probable for Monday's game against Philadelphia.

injuries.name: Peyton Watson
injuries.detail: Watson (hamstring) is questionable to play in Monday's game against Oklahoma City.

injuries.name: Jaylon Tyson
injuries.detail: Tyson (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against Oklahoma City.

injuries.name: Kyrie Irving
injuries.detail: Irving (knee) is questionable to play Monday against the Kings.

injuries.name: Santi Aldama
injuries.detail: Aldama (knee) is listed as doubtful for Monday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.detail: Lively (foot) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Kings.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.detail: Head coach Dusty May said Friday that de Larrea (knee) will be re-evaluated next week, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reports.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.detail: Biberovic (heel) is listed as out for Monday's game against Sacramento.

injuries.name: Spencer Jones
injuries.detail: Jones (hamstring) is listed as out for Monday's game against the Trail Blazers.

injuries.name: Alpha Diallo
injuries.detail: Diallo (wrist) is listed as questionable for Monday's game versus Portland.

injuries.name: Julian Strawther
injuries.detail: Strawther (knee) was diagnosed with a left knee sprain Friday and will be re-evaluated in six weeks, Vinny Benedetto of The Denver Gazette reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.detail: Duren will be re-evaluated in two weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Isaiah Joe
injuries.detail: Joe (hip) is questionable for Friday's game against the Hornets.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.detail: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Stephen Curry
injuries.detail: Curry (rest) won't play Sunday against the Clippers, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Draymond Green
injuries.detail: Green (back) is out for Sunday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.detail: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March, Anthony Slater of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Gui Santos
injuries.detail: Santos did not play in the second half of Sunday's 124-112 win over the Clippers due to a knee injury and will not play against the Suns on Monday, Danny Emerman of SFStandard.com reports.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.detail: The Warriors are exploring potential trades involving Porzingis (personal), who remains away from the team indefinitely while dealing with ongoing health concerns, Anthony Slater of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Reed Sheppard
injuries.detail: Sheppard (back) is questionable for Monday's game against the Celtics.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.detail: Head coach Ime Udoka said Monday that Adams could be out "a week or two" due to his right soleus strain, Lachard Binkley of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Clint Capela
injuries.detail: Capela (ankle) is questionable to play in Monday's game against the Celtics.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.detail: Haliburton (hamstring) will miss at least the next two weeks of action, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Ivica Zubac
injuries.detail: Zubac (ankle) will remain on the inactive list for Sunday's game against the Nets.

injuries.name: Johnny Furphy
injuries.detail: Furphy (knee) is practicing with the G League's Noblesville Boom, per Alex Golden of SI.com.

injuries.name: Obi Toppin
injuries.detail: Toppin (back) is out for Sunday's game against the Nets, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.detail: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.detail: Indiana recalled McConnell (hamstring) from the G League's Noblesville Boom on Saturday.

injuries.name: Brandon Ingram
injuries.detail: The Clippers recalled Ingram (Achilles) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

injuries.name: Derrick Jones Jr.
injuries.detail: Jones (right knee) has been ruled out for the rest of Sunday's game against the Clippers, Ohm Youngmisuk of ESPN.com reports.

injuries.name: Max Strus
injuries.detail: The Clippers recalled Strus (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.detail: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer Justin Russo reports.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.detail: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months, per Law Murray of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Yanic Konan Niederhauser
injuries.detail: The Clippers recalled Niederhauser (foot) from the G League's San Diego Clippers on Sunday.

injuries.name: Ziaire Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (foot) is out for Sunday's game against the Raptors.

injuries.name: Adou Thiero
injuries.detail: Thiero (knee) has been ruled out for Sunday's game against the Raptors.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.detail: Pippen (back) is listed as doubtful for Monday's game against the Pelicans.

injuries.name: Quinten Post
injuries.detail: Post (ankle) is questionable to suit up for Monday's game against New Orleans.

injuries.name: Tim Hardaway Jr.
injuries.detail: Hardaway (personal) is listed as questionable for Monday's game against the Lakers.

injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.detail: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.detail: DiVincenzo (Achilles) remains confident that he'll return during the 2026-27 season, Jon Krawczynski of The Athletic reports.

injuries.name: Trey Murphy III
injuries.detail: Murphy (knee) is listed as probable for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Yves Missi
injuries.detail: Missi (knee) won't play in Saturday's game against Atlanta.

injuries.name: Jordan Poole
injuries.detail: Poole (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Jose Alvarado
injuries.detail: Alvarado (ankle) is questionable for Monday's game against the Nets.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.detail: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks, Nick Crain of Slam reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.detail: Williams (leg) underwent successful surgery Wednesday to "address a fractured left fibula and reconstruction of ankle ligaments following a fracture and dislocation." He will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Tim MacMaho

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.detail: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Alex Caruso
injuries.detail: Caruso (ankle) is expected to miss time due to an ankle sprain, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.detail: Topic (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game in Dallas.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.detail: Oklahoma City exercised the third-year team option on Sorber (knee) on Sunday, Clemente Almanza of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.detail: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jalen Suggs
injuries.detail: Suggs has been diagnosed with a mild bone bruise in his right knee and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.detail: Orlando recalled Isaac (knee) from the G League's Osceola Magic on Sunday.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.detail: Penda was diagnosed with a partially torn right hamstring Saturday, Jason Beede of the Orlando Sentinel reports.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.detail: Team president Jeff Weltman said Monday that Nelson (ankle) remains about a month away from returning to the court after offseason surgery, per Philip Rossman-Reich of OrlandoMagicDaily.com.

injuries.name: Joel Embiid
injuries.detail: Embiid (foot) is questionable to suit up for Monday's game against the Bulls.

injuries.name: Dominick Barlow
injuries.detail: Barlow will miss at least the next two weeks of action due to a lumbar spine bone stress response, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.detail: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.detail: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time, Shams Charania of ESPN reports.

injuries.name: Ja Morant
injuries.detail: Morant has been diagnosed with a Grade 2 left hamstring strain and is expected to miss four weeks, Portland announced Friday.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.detail: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.detail: Harris (calf) is listed as out for Saturday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.detail: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.detail: Raynaud (knee) is progressing in his rehabilitation and will be re-evaluated in approximately two weeks, Brenden Nunes of KHTK Sactown Sports 1140 reports.

injuries.name: Zach LaVine
injuries.detail: LaVine (elbow) is questionable to play in Monday's game against Dallas.

injuries.name: Keegan Murray
injuries.detail: Murray (ankle) will be re-evaluated in 10-to-14 days, NBA reporter Marc Stein reports.

injuries.name: Dylan Cardwell
injuries.detail: Cardwell (calf) is questionable to suit up for Monday's game against the Mavericks.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.detail: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon, James Ham of ESPN 1320 Sacramento reports.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.detail: Leonard (knee) is expected to be sidelined for at least three to four weeks, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

injuries.name: Jakob Poeltl
injuries.detail: Poeltl (shoulder) won't play in Sunday's game against the Lakers, Vivek Jacob of the Raptors' official site reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.detail: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Magic, Cody Taylor of USA Today reports.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.detail: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks, per Shams Charania of ESPN.

injuries.name: Jusuf Nurkic
injuries.detail: Nurkic will miss at least the next four weeks due to a partial plantar plate tear of second toe in right foot, Chris Haynes of NBA TV reports.

injuries.name: Trey Alexander
injuries.detail: Alexander won't play Wednesday against the Grizzlies due to a left knee bone bruise.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.detail: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Anthony Gill
injuries.detail: Gill (back) is questionable to suit up in Monday's contest against Orlando.

injuries.name: Alex Sarr
injuries.detail: Sarr (knee) is questionable to play in Monday's game against the Magic.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.detail: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months, per Josh Robbins of The Athletic.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.detail: Vukcevic (hip) is listed as out for Monday's game against Orlando.
